descripcion: A newborn world, at night, with Lumen, the guardian of the workshop. Learn to build in 11 short missions: place, move, switch off and, at the end, wire cables so the lantern lights up when you decide.
notas: The engine's default template (plantillas/taller; internal id «taller», visible name «Learn to Build», published as numinia-assets/mundos/learn-to-build/): what every new world is born with. `version` is the semantic version of this world; `creador` and `dueno` follow the world sheet (docs/FICHA-MUNDO-TALLER.md). Change its name and description whenever you like.
